description: This file defines the interface 'LoanApplicationWritePlatformService' for handling loan application operations such as submit, modify, approve, reject, and undo approval within the Fineract project. It declares methods that accept loan identifiers and command objects, returning results indicating processing outcomes.

classes.name: LoanApplicationWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining loan application operations such as submit, modify, approve, reject, and undo approval.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Submits a new loan application based on the provided command.

methods.name: modifyApplication
methods.description: Modifies an existing loan application identified by loanId with the provided command.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes an existing loan application identified by loanId.

methods.name: approveApplication
methods.description: Approves the loan application identified by loanId using the provided command.

methods.name: undoApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverts the approval of a loan application identified by loanId.

methods.name: rejectApplication
methods.description: Rejects the loan application identified by loanId.

methods.name: applicantWithdrawsFromApplication
methods.description: Handles the applicant's withdrawal from the application process.

methods.name: approveGLIMLoanAppication
methods.description: Approves a GLIM (Group Lending Incentive Model) loan application.

methods.name: undoGLIMLoanApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverts the approval of a GLIM loan application.
